actions.action: Separate public placements from restricted access needs
actions.mechanism: Publish a minimal seating view rather than sharing or hiding columns in the private spreadsheet.
actions.implementation: Create a separate public list containing attendee-chosen identifiers, tables, and seats. Restrict access requirements and contact details to seating coordinators; remove accommodation narratives.
actions.check: Open the public list as an attendee; verify private fields, comments, revision history, and source-sheet access are unavailable.
actions.risk: Previously shared copies require separate cleanup.

actions.action: Assign hard requirements before pairing preferences
actions.mechanism: Allocate required aisle placements only among the four qualifying seats; treat pairing as optional.
actions.implementation: Preserve confirmed accessible placements, allocate remaining qualifying seats to outstanding access needs, then optimize pairs. Mark excess access requests unresolved; never substitute unsuitable seats.
actions.check: Request a late pair when only separated seats remain: offer those seats without displacing accessible placements. A fifth access request stays unresolved.
actions.risk: An unresolved request is not a confirmed placement.

actions.action: Protect confirmed placements during cancellation updates
actions.mechanism: Stage changes before publication and block removal of confirmed accessible placements until attendee contact is recorded.
actions.implementation: Give each update a version number. Compare proposed changes against confirmed placements; require recorded contact before removal and a suitable replacement before any reassignment.
actions.check: Simulate a stale cancellation import removing a confirmed accessible placement; publication must fail without contact. Conflicting edits must require reconciliation.
actions.risk: A sent message alone may not establish contact.

actions.action: Verify clear routes in the actual room
actions.mechanism: Check physical seating conditions independently of spreadsheet validity; a correct assignment cannot guarantee an unobstructed route.
actions.implementation: Label the four qualifying seats. Before opening and after furniture moves, check their required routes. Correct obstructions; contact affected attendees before changing confirmed placements.
actions.check: Place a bag in a qualifying route during setup testing; staff must detect and remove it before marking that seat ready.
actions.risk: Do not label seats with attendees’ accommodation reasons.
